text: {"side":"artifact","claims":[{"text":"The known-issue checklist flags emulsion_non_blue on 41 of 447 points, so a non-blue emulsion response could contribute to the apparent dimming.","evidence_ids":["E-057"]},{"text":"Blend_suspect is flagged on 62 of 447 points, and the strongest dimming points in the event (E-045, E-047, E-048, E-049, E-050, E-051, E-052, E-054, E-055) carry the BLEND_SUSPECT tag, so a neighbouring star on the plate could be causing the dip.","evidence_ids":["E-059","E-045","E-047","E-048","E-049","E-050","E-051","E-052","E-054","E-055"]},{"text":"Shape_outlier is flagged on 130 of 447 points, and most of the event's deepest measurements (E-045, E-046, E-047, E-048, E-049, E-051, E-052, E-053, E-054, E-055) carry the SHAPE_OUTLIER tag, suggesting image-shape problems rather than stellar variability.","evidence_ids":["E-061","E-045","E-046","E-047","E-048","E-049","E-051","E-052","E-053","E-054","E-055"]},{"text":"The 1950 to 1960s decade medians are strongly negative (-0.491 in the 1950s with scatter 0.646, and -0.192 in the 1960s with scatter 0.527), and the event lies in the 1925 to 1952 window, so a plate-series or calibration seam at the 1950 boundary could mimic a long-term dimming trend; series ac has a zero point of -0.202 across 155 points, versus about +0.15 for the early series.","evidence_ids":["E-011","E-012","E-016","E-005","E-029"]},{"text":"Plate_edge is flagged on 13 of 447 points, and the event is built from only 30 listed points out of 447 with 15 points thinned to fit the budget, so a missing or edge-affected point could distort the apparent event shape; the evidence does not show which listed points are plate-edge cases, so this cannot be confirmed from the packet.","evidence_ids":["E-062","E-056"]}]}
